text: The paper reports (Table 4) a bias score of 29.0 for Self-Reflect vs. 24.8 for MAD, where bias is the human-labelled rate of translations not conforming to commonsense, and a diversity score (100 minus Self-BLEU between the initial and current translation) of 19.3 vs. 49.7.
title: MAD lowers translation bias and raises diversity compared with self-reflection
